adjudication.rationale: In `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host`, the lookup is `where("lower(host) = ?", host).first` after `host = uri.host`. The SQL lowercases only the DB column; the bound parameter is not normalized (e.g., `host.downcase`). In a case-sensitive DB (e.g., Postgres), if `uri.host` can retain uppercase letters, `lower(host) = 'EvilTrout.COM'` will not match a stored `eviltrout.com`, causing `host_allowed?` to incorrectly reject/deny valid referers/URLs differing only by case.
